title: GPU Resource Management
summary: This module provides command-line utilities for probing and orchestrating GPU resources. It acts as an interface to initiate GPU-related operations based on command-line flags.

nodes.label: Receive Command Line Arguments
nodes.title: CLI Input
nodes.description: Input arguments provided via the command line, including flags like 'gpu_run' that control GPU orchestration behavior.

nodes.label: Initiate GPU Probe Command
nodes.title: GPU Probe CLI Entry Point
nodes.description: Parses command-line arguments, checks for specific flags (e.g., 'gpu_run'), logs the activation status, and orchestrates the underlying GPU probing process.

nodes.label: Execute Core GPU Probing Logic
nodes.title: Core GPU Probing Function
nodes.description: Performs the actual low-level probing and interaction with the system's GPU resources to gather information or execute specific GPU-related operations.

nodes.label: Interact with System GPU Resources
nodes.title: Hardware/Software GPUs
nodes.description: The underlying GPU hardware, drivers, and associated APIs that are being probed, monitored, or managed by the module.

nodes.label: Log Operational Information
nodes.title: Application Logger
nodes.description: Records operational messages, status updates, and debugging information to provide insights into the module's execution.
